'''Phosphor''' is a glowing material used to make light sources. It replaces the {{MCW|Glow Ink Sac|glow ink sac}}, and unlike its vanilla counterpart it can be made in quantity from [[Glow Lichen|glow lichen]], so the pack's light blocks, [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] and [[Phosphor Rod|phosphor rods]], do not depend on hunting glow squids.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Glass Bottle#Water bottle|water bottle]], a [[Sulfur Chunk|sulfur chunk]] and four glow lichen make 8 phosphor.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/phosphor.json}}</ref> The empty [[Glass Bottle|glass bottle]] is given back after crafting.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref> The recipe unlocks when the player picks up glow lichen or phosphor.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/phosphor.json}}</ref>

The recipe accepts any potion in the bottle slot, not only water; the pack renames the plain, contentless potion shown in the recipe book "Water Bottle" so that the ingredient reads correctly.

=== Mob loot ===
Glow squids drop phosphor as in vanilla.

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
* [[Phosphor Rod|Phosphor rods]]: three phosphor between six glass panes make 6.
* [[Phosphor lamps]]: four phosphor, four glass and a dye make 4 lamps.
* Glow item frames and glowing signs, as in vanilla.
* The "far" [[Music Disc|music disc]]: eight disc fragments around a phosphor.
